mapper.sql: id, name, slug, description, status, map_model_url, player_character_json, player_spawn_json, robot_spawn_json, robot_story, story_graph_json, zombie_spawns_json, map_characters_json, placed_objects_json, max_players, published_at, archived_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM levels ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO levels ( id, name, slug, description, status, map_model_url, player_character_json, player_spawn_json, robot_spawn_json, robot_story, story_graph_json, zombie_spawns_json, map_characters_json, placed_objects_json, max_players, published_at, archived_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{description}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{status}, ''), 'draft'), #{mapModelUrl}, #{playerCharacterJson}, #{playerSpawnJson}, #{robotSpawnJson}, COALESCE(#{robotStory}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{storyGraphJson}, ''), '{"nodes":[],"edges":[],"variables":[]}'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{zombieSpawnsJson}, ''), '[]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{mapCharactersJson}, ''), '[]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{placedObjectsJson}, ''), '[]'), COALESCE(#{maxPlayers}, 50), #{publishedAt}, #{archivedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name, slug = excluded.slug, description = excluded.description, status = excluded.status, map_model_url = excluded.map_model_url, player_character_json = excluded.player_character_json, player_spawn_json = excluded.player_spawn_json, robot_spawn_json = excluded.robot_spawn_json, robot_story = excluded.robot_story, story_graph_json = excluded.story_graph_json, zombie_spawns_json = excluded.zombie_spawns_json, map_characters_json = excluded.map_characters_json, placed_objects_json = excluded.placed_objects_json, max_players = excluded.max_players, published_at = excluded.published_at, archived_at = excluded.archived_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
